plain.title: STM32F103C8T6 Blue Pill
comments: USB, reset, boot selection and SWD

texts.text: POWER + USB
USB input and local regulator bypassing
MCU + CLOCK
8 MHz HSE with matched load capacitors
CONTROL
Reset pull-up and boot-mode strap
HEADERS
GPIO headers expose the MCU interface
NOTES
USB VBUS powers the 3.3 V LDO.
BOOT0 jumper selects system memory boot.
PA13/PA14 and NRST are routed to SWD.
